description: Indoor gym, phone held by a second person (camera moves between shots), one shooter. 960x540 with the portrait picture pillarboxed, 29.97 fps, 112.7 s.
labelling: Shot times are when the ball drops through the rim, checked frame by frame. Candidates came from the Python reference detector (28 found) plus a scan for ball flights near the hoop that it missed (2 more).
limitations: Every shot in this clip is a make, so it measures whether shots are found and whether makes are wrongly called misses, but not whether real misses are caught.
rimSegments_note: The phone was moved three times. Each segment is the rim lock a user would set after moving it (rim ring centre and half-width, in video pixels). Used for manual/hybrid runs and to check auto rim finding.

shots.note: Exits the bottom-left of the net; net flips.
